checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["brainstem","brain","multi","asset"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; for (const k of Object.keys(s)) { const v = s[k]; if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 6) return true; if (typeof v === 'number' && v >= 6) return true; } return false; })()
